title: TURTLE BRIGADE recruiting
description: Puts a Prospect IV forward for TURTLE BRIGADE, PERMAFLEET's infantry (offered by the recruiting campaign in contracts/recruiting.json). Answers are recorded per member for PERMAFLEET leadership, who select who joins.

welcome.say: Hi {{user.name}}! Your answers go to PERMAFLEET leadership, who select who joins **TURTLE BRIGADE**. Nothing is sent until you confirm at the end, and Cancel stops at any point.

experience.say: How much FPS have you played in Star Citizen?

options.label: Some
options.description: Bunkers and FPS missions now and then

options.label: Regularly
options.description: FPS is most of what I play

options.label: Competitive
options.description: PvP, Star Marine, or other shooters at a high level

fireteam.say: What do you like to do on the ground? Pick everything that fits.

when.say: When do you usually play (your local time)? Pick everything that fits.

handle.say: What's your RSI handle? It's the name in your RSI profile link (robertsspaceindustries.com/citizens/<handle>).

application.say: Have you filled out the squadron application? One application covers every squadron, and it's also required to join G00N SQUAD: {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/operations/PERMAFLEET/squadrons#squadron-apply

notes.say: Anything leadership should know? Past units or orgs, clips, a squadmate who can vouch for you. Skip if not.

complete.say: Sent. PERMAFLEET leadership reviews every name and selects who joins TURTLE BRIGADE; you'll hear from them on Discord. Until then, keep showing up for ops: {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/operations/PERMAFLEET/schedule

cancelled.say: No problem, nothing was sent. When you're ready, the squadron application is at {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/operations/PERMAFLEET/squadrons#squadron-apply
